sections.title: Customers
sections.description: Everything you need to submit complaints, upload evidence and track status.

topics.title: Create a complaint
topics.summary: How to submit a new case with all mandatory fields and confirmation steps.

steps.title: Sign in & start
steps.description: Sign in and choose "New complaint" on the dashboard. Use the quick action to jump directly into the form.

steps.title: Add product & lot
steps.description: Pick the product category, item and lot. Mandatory fields are highlighted – incomplete values can be added later.

steps.title: Upload photos & documents
steps.description: Attach photos or PDFs. Use the markup tool to highlight affected areas. Maximum total size: 10 MB.

steps.title: Review summary
steps.description: Verify your details. The "Automatic help" panel suggests relevant knowledge base answers for missing information.

steps.title: Submit & confirmation
steps.description: Send the complaint. You receive a ticket number and confirmation by email.

tips: Use draft mode if you need to continue later.
You can add attachments after submission via the ticket details page.
The "Automatic help" button shows matching guidance from the knowledge base.

topics.title: Status & communication
topics.summary: Understand statuses, answer questions and reach your contact person.

steps.title: Read the status badges
steps.description: Use the badges (Received, In progress, Decision, etc.) to understand progress.

steps.title: Send messages
steps.description: Open the ticket details and use the chat area to ask or answer questions. Representatives and QM receive notifications automatically.

steps.title: Add follow-up files
steps.description: Upload more photos/documents that are linked directly to the ticket.

steps.title: Open reports
steps.description: Depending on permissions you can see lab reports and CAPA updates. Hidden documents are restricted for compliance reasons.

tips: Keep replies short and add a photo if possible.
For urgent cases also use the "Contact representative" button in the ticket.
Download links are personal – please do not forward them.

sections.title: Representatives
sections.description: Manage knowledge articles, customer communication and decisions.

topics.title: Dashboard & filters
topics.summary: Filter all customer cases by priority and status.

steps.title: Login & role switch
steps.description: Sign in to the representative area. The role switch shows whether you are in customer or representative context.

steps.title: Apply filters
steps.description: Use status, decision and customer filters. Saved filters appear in quick access.

steps.title: Downloads & catalogs
steps.description: Access released documents (e.g. reports, catalogs). Visibility depends on your region and language.

tips: Open the customer profile to jump directly to their open tickets.
Mark urgent tickets with a star to keep them on top.

topics.title: Evaluate & approve
topics.summary: Document decisions in a traceable way.

steps.title: Open the ticket
steps.description: Open the ticket and choose "Evaluate".

steps.title: Capture the decision
steps.description: Provide the decision, rationale and optionally a CAPA. Add internal notes for PRRC.

steps.title: Approval & visibility
steps.description: Define whether the decision is visible for customers. Internal assessments stay limited to DFS/PRRC and reps.

tips: Set a follow-up date when documents are missing.
PRRC note: every decision needs a source (lab report, customer photo, CAPA).

sections.title: DFS users & PRRC
sections.description: Internal area for quality assurance, CAPA management and approvals.

topics.title: CAPA & reports
topics.summary: Create CAPA items, upload reports and manage visibility.

steps.title: Create a CAPA
steps.description: Open the admin dashboard and pick "New CAPA". Link the ticket, root cause and action.

steps.title: Upload reports
steps.description: Upload PDF reports and decide whether they are visible for customers/representatives.

steps.title: Roles & permissions
steps.description: Visibility follows roles: customers only see released reports, representatives see internal notes, PRRC sees all assessments.

tips: Use tags (segment, region) to find reports faster.
Audit tip: every CAPA needs a responsible person and due date.

topics.title: PRRC focus
topics.summary: Clear guidance on assessments, approvals, rights & visibility.

steps.title: Evidence for assessments
steps.description: Store evidence (lab results, lot checks, customer communication). Each assessment receives a timestamp.

steps.title: Document approvals
steps.description: Approvals are two-step: representative recommendation and PRRC final approval. Both are logged.

steps.title: Manage rights & visibility
steps.description: Set visibility per document: PRRC-only, Internal (DFS/rep) or Customer visible. Every change creates an audit trail.

steps.title: Share deep links
steps.description: Use secure deep links for audits. Links are signed and time-limited.

tips: Use the PRRC protocol export for audits.
Always verify visibility before sharing – the app shows the current approval level.
